purpose: Separate valid neutral market structure from insufficient evidence, prevent coverage inflation, and compare strict 1D+4H agreement against a conservative 1D-primary/4H-confirmation design.

timeframe_semantics.DIRECTIONAL: price impulse and candle body are coherent AND either wave_energy_atr >= 1.0 OR confirmed volume with wave_energy_atr >= 0.20 and body_efficiency >= 0.25
timeframe_semantics.TRUE_NEUTRAL: not directional AND volume participation >= 0.80 of both prior MA5 and MA10 AND wave_energy_atr <= 0.35 AND body_efficiency <= 0.35
timeframe_semantics.critical_rule: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is never mapped to NEUTRAL and never adds 15 coverage points
timeframe_semantics.tiny_move_guard: average-or-higher volume alone is insufficient for a directional state when directional displacement/body efficiency are too small

B_1D_PRIMARY.LONG_SHORT: 1D DIRECTIONAL is primary; accept if 4H same direction, or if 4H TRUE_NEUTRAL and 1D directional_quality >= 2

coverage_policy.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: do not inject VOLUME_WAVE into score engine; preserve baseline N/A record
